Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth

Class ReplayRejectingJwtValidator

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth.ReplayRejectingJwtValidator
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.OAuth2TokenValidator<org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt>
public class ReplayRejectingJwtValidator extends Object implements org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.OAuth2TokenValidator<org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt>
Validates what the framework's default assertion validators leave out: the assertion must carry a jti, an iat no later than now (within the same clock skew the framework's timestamp validator allows) and an exp no more than the configured maximum lifetime after it, so a future iat cannot stretch the window, and its jti must not have been used before by the same client (RFC 7523, section 3). The use is recorded last, only for an assertion that passed the other checks, so a refused assertion never consumes its identifier. The record is made through RegisterClientAssertionUseCase, so the replay protection is shared by every instance of the server.
